in_hebrew.name: Fletch
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fletch הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word 'fleotan', meaning to shoot with an arrow. In medieval Europe, a fletcher was a skilled craftsman who made and repaired arrows for archers.
